  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "machine_assignment_of_operations",
      "evidence": "Operations from different jobs that require the same machine must be scheduled in a specific order to avoid overlapping. ... if Operation 0 of Job 0 is scheduled before Operation 0 of Job 1, the binary variable is set to 1",
      "options": [
        "operation index o is the machine: operations (j,o) and (k,o) share a machine (conflict iff same operation number)",

      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.3,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "operation index o is the machine: operations (j,o) and (k,o) share a machine (conflict iff same operation number)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "makespan_constraint_scope",
      "evidence": "The makespan must be at least as long as the completion time of the last operation across all jobs. ... the makespan constraints ensure that the makespan is at least as large as the completion time of every operation.",
      "options": [
        "Cmax >= s[j,o] + p[j,o] for every operation (j,o)",
        "Cmax >= s[j,last] + p[j,last] only for the last operation of each job"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.15
      ],
      "majority_option": "Cmax >= s[j,o] + p[j,o] for every operation (j,o)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "big_M_value",
      "evidence": "A large constant (100,000) is used in the constraints to ensure they are only active when necessary.",
      "options": [
        "M = 100000 as stated",
        "M = tight bound (e.g. sum of all processing times)",
        "M = any sufficiently large value (e.g. 1e6)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.7,
        0.2,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "M = 100000 as stated"
    },
    {
      "decision": "ordering_variable_definition",
      "evidence": "Binary decision variables determine the order of operations on shared machines. For instance, if Operation 0 of Job 0 is scheduled before Operation 0 of Job 1, the binary variable is set to 1; otherwise, it is set to 0.",
      "options": [
        "one binary y[a,b] per unordered conflicting pair, with two big-M disjunctive constraints",
        "one binary per ordered pair (directed), with a single big-M constraint per ordered pair",
        "binary defined over all operation pairs, not only conflicting ones"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.25,
        0.15
      ],
      "majority_option": "one binary y[a,b] per unordered conflicting pair, with two big-M disjunctive constraints"
    },
    {
      "decision": "start_time_domain",
      "evidence": "The start times for all operations must be non-negative ... The start times and the makespan are continuous variables",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Reals (unbounded below)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.9,
        0.08,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_expression",
      "evidence": "the objective is to minimize the makespan while satisfying all precedence and machine capacity constraints",
      "options": [
        "minimize Cmax",
        "minimize sum of completion times (total completion time)",
        "minimize Cmax plus small tie-breaker on start times"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.9,
        0.07,
        0.03
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize Cmax"
    }
  ]
